data: Binance spot 1-minute bars of BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP and the extra data of OR-HM2, 2020-01-01 to 2025-12-31 UTC. A = 2020-2024 (the direction and every choice come from A), B = 2025 (every *_B number).
fire: onset: a row fires at the first minute close at which every condition in `conds` holds one of its levels (each reading at the last CLOSED bar of its own timeframe; a position or clock level is that of the entry minute) after a close at which they did not all hold; the entry is the open of the next minute. A model row fires when the GBM score enters its zone. A pair or triple row's headline numbers (n, share, odds, t, wd, oheat, hold; A and B) are what that fire gave (its onset block); `scan` holds the scan's held-state numbers that ranked it, `held` every minute the state held; onset_agrees_A says whether the onset's own A direction is dir.
rule: Per coin, kind and horizon: the 40 best cells by oheat_B, the 40 best by iheat_B and the 20 best by lheat_B, and the same lists over the cells no HM1 pack or stored pair holds (seen_in_league none); at most 3 rows per reading in a list; exact and near copies (80% of B entries shared) are one row with aliases. No pass mark filters a row: hot_A, replicated_B, bhy and the above-twin-max flags are columns. Unknown kinds (Part 3 gate rows: gate, gate2) must be skipped by a loader that does not know them.

units.odds_*: odds points (50 x the mean-sign shift over the base) in the row direction
units.iota_*: odds points the joint state gives beyond its parts (raw: positive = up; d_iota = its A sign; iota_robust: the two scales agree)
units.iheat_B: windows per day x iota_robust_B in its A direction
units.lift_min_*: odds points over the weaker part, in the row direction
units.share_*: % of entries beyond the entry price by more than 1.5 price steps on the called side
units.onset: g.full on the onset minutes of every 2025 minute (the fire): move, best move and usual dip in bps, hold in minutes, retL = the move entered one minute later, move_steps = move / the price step
units.held: the same on every minute the state holds
units.n_*: scan entries (A: every 7th valid minute; B: every valid minute)
units.parts: each part alone on A (the scan's part effects): odds_A and t_A raw (positive = up)
units.share_* / hold_*: in the row direction (share_over_B / hold_over_B: over the B base of that direction)

feed_rule: perp, funding and open interest need a Binance perpetual feed; macro needs a 2026 calendar; daily markets need their daily closes; Coinbase readings need a Coinbase minute feed
